playbooks.changePlanInstruction: Do not edit files yet. Read the task brief, evidence, and repository, then write a concrete plan: which files and sections to change, what to change them to, and why. If the brief does not match the repository (a page was renamed, the content already exists, the location is unsuitable, and so on), point it out and propose an approach.
playbooks.communityReplyInstruction: Draft one reply for each post in the evidence. Open the original post first and read its full contents and existing replies, then look for answers in the repository documentation and knowledge base. Use a separate section for each post with this fixed format: a first line headed "## Original post title", followed by four lines: "- Link: original post URL", "- Asking: a one-sentence summary", "- References: documentation titles and URLs or repository paths used (write None if there are none)", and "- Docs gap: what the docs do not explain clearly and need to cover (write None if there are none)". Then add "### Reply" followed by the reply text. Keep Link, Asking, References, Docs gap, Reply, and the empty-value marker None exactly as shown. Write the field values and reply text in the original post's language, in a friendly, direct community-member voice: answer the question first, then link to the docs. State any uncertainty and suggest how to verify it; do not invent features, configuration, or version numbers. After all posts, add "## Summary" listing the documentation that needs to be added. Write drafts only; do not post replies or modify the repository.
